category: product analytics with session replay, experiments and feature flags (hosted)

free_tier.stated: Free plan, free forever with no credit card required: up to 1M events per month, unlimited seats, 10K session replays per month, up to 1k monthly experiment users, up to 10 active feature flags, 5 saved reports per seat; the Query API is not part of Free
free_tier.notes: Events, session replays and experiment users each have their own monthly count, so no single unit of the vocabulary fits. The Growth plan starts at USD 0 for the first 1M events a month and bills further events by volume tier; what the Free plan does with events past 1M is unverified: not stated on the pages read.

per_object_cap.stated: the import endpoint accepts up to 2000 events and 10MB uncompressed per request

retention.stated: event data is deleted 2 years after ingestion by default on Free, Growth and Enterprise, and a custom policy is an Enterprise feature; session replays are kept 30 days

egress.terms: the Query API, which downloads reports as CSV, PNG or PDF or exports results to JSON or CSV, is not available on Free; whether the Raw Data Export API is open to a Free project is unverified: the pricing page lists only Ingestion & export API access (Import historical data) as available

interface_detail: The Ingestion API (import and track endpoints) authenticates with a project token as the basic auth username or with an Owner or Admin service account, at api.mixpanel.com or api-eu.mixpanel.com for EU data residency; an MCP server and Mixpanel Headless (work with Mixpanel as code) are listed as available on Free. The Query API is not part of Free.
tooling: the Ingestion API, an MCP server, Mixpanel Headless and the web app
chaining: Event analytics, funnels and retention for the front end of a free-hosted app, up to 1M events a month, with 10K session replays and 10 feature flags in the same project.

limits.value: up to 1M events per month on Free
10K session replays and 1k monthly experiment users per month; up to 10 active feature flags
Ingestion API: 2GB of uncompressed JSON per minute or about 30k events per second, per project
2000 events and 10MB uncompressed per import request
events deleted after 2 years by default; session replays kept 30 days

binding_note: The 1M events a month is the first ceiling for an app with traffic, and the missing Query API means reports are read in the web app only.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up page offers a free account from an email address, with an agreement to the terms; the pricing page states no credit card is required. Any later step is unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: no throttle, ban or data loss is stated on the pages read beyond the 2-year event retention and the 30-day session replay retention; a 429 answer means a per-project rate limit was reached
confidence_note: Plan limits are quoted from the first-party pricing page and the rate limits from its API documentation. No account was opened, so the behaviour past 1M events and any later sign-up step are unverified: behind a sign-up.
